setup.zh: 潮回来了，一浪一浪，把流波山的根盖住。海上的城散了。渔船出海。
setup.en: The tide comes back, wave upon wave, and covers the root of Mount Liubo. The city on the sea is gone. The boats put out.

recap.zh: 潮回来了，海上的城散了，渔船出海。第四鼎在南边的泗水。
recap.en: The tide came back, the city on the sea faded, and the boats put out. The fourth cauldron lay south, on the Si.

text.zh: 第四鼎的气息在南边——徐州，泗水之畔。你醒来的地方。
text.en: The fourth cauldron's breath lies south — Xu, by the Si River. Where you woke.

exits.means: rests, ends the chapter, asks what comes next

text.zh: 今日到此为止。徐州的路，开的时候我会告诉你。
text.en: That is all for today. When the road to Xu opens, I will tell you.
